milestones.title: Smoother saves for persistent worlds
milestones.summary: Save changed world and player state in smaller batches while gameplay continues, with safe recovery after interruptions.
milestones.availability_note: Saved-round job capacity restoration is merged and deployed on the local Nomads server. A fresh player's Join flow remains unverified. Save/load operation guards are in progress; full recovery and public availability of this goal are not yet verified.

evidence.label: Restore job capacity after loading a saved round
Prevent overlapping world saves and imports

milestones.title: Extraction survival
milestones.summary: Explore dangerous areas, collect loot and return to a persistent safehouse. Extraction and survival shape what you keep between runs. Planned for in-game eras starting in 1943 and onward.
milestones.availability_note: Early drafts. Development changes do not yet establish a playable public release. Instanced save/load, collision reservations and raid transport remain pending.

milestones.title: A train home for your party
milestones.summary: A planned shared train with a protected party compartment that stays safe while raid-docked, a party airlock and safe exit, normal hunger and thirst limits, and independent berths for selected players only. Planned for in-game eras starting in 1943 and onward.
milestones.availability_note: Early layout draft. An expanded layout, airlock and survival rules are in development. Working transport, instanced saves, collision reservations and raid travel still need implementation and runtime testing.

milestones.title: Industrialization: pipes, pumps and foundries
milestones.summary: Develop industrialization systems with pipes, pumps and foundries.
milestones.availability_note: A planned development goal; details may change as development and testing progress. Public availability has not been verified.

milestones.title: Real-time travel between hosted servers
milestones.summary: Plan real-time travel between Civ13-hosted servers: safely unload a character from one server and transfer it to another. Requires compatible eras and persistence game modes, shared character identity and transfer ownership, protected inventory/state custody, destination readiness and recovery from interruptions to prevent duplication or loss.
milestones.availability_note: A planned goal. Compatibility, transfer and recovery behavior still need design and testing; public availability has not been verified.

milestones.title: Windows server bot integration
milestones.summary: Develop isolated Windows startup support for the server management bot.
milestones.availability_note: A draft implementation is under review. It has not been activated or verified against a live Windows server.

milestones.title: Discord social integration
milestones.summary: Explore optional Rich Presence, joining friends and invitations through a compatible game client.
milestones.availability_note: An idea for future investigation; implementation has not started.
